estructuras.nombre: error comun: el genio se va, vendes

frases.texto: Colette Kress, a finance chief most people never heard of, now runs the biggest stock your index fund owns.
Her boss, Jensen Huang, just quit.
Reports tied him to an alleged Chinese spy.
Nvidia fell as much as fourteen percent.
The reflex: the genius leaves, so you sell.
When Steve Jobs quit, Apple sank overnight.
His quiet replacement built America's first trillion-dollar company.
Jack Welch left General Electric.
Under his successor, the stock fell nearly thirty percent while the market more than doubled.
Same panic, opposite endings.
Nobody could tell which was which.
Kress keeps the seat warm; the next boss decides which ending your index fund gets.

estructuras.nombre: cuenta atras: tres CEOs que se fueron

frases.texto: Colette Kress, Nvidia's finance chief, woke up running the biggest stock in your index fund.
Jensen Huang quit after reports tied him to an alleged Chinese spy.
Nvidia fell as much as fourteen percent.
Three legends, three exits.
Number three: Jack Welch leaves General Electric.
The stock fell nearly thirty percent under his successor.
Number two: Steve Jobs leaves Apple, and the stock sinks overnight.
Then his replacement builds America's first trillion-dollar company.
Number one is Nvidia, and nobody knows the ending yet.
Panic looked the same both times.
The next boss decides which story your index fund is in.

error.nota: One idea (same panic, opposite endings); Apple vs GE twist lands at the midpoint; close loops back to Kress and the index fund.

cuenta.nota: Countdown is clear but telegraphs the order; number-one payoff is weaker because the ending is unknown.

error+g1.nota: Unknown name plus 'biggest stock in your index fund' opens the loop; the Apple/GE split pays it off; last line returns to Kress.

error+g2.nota: Huang is the obvious headline; no curiosity gap, everyone has seen it.

error+g3.nota: Problem is vague and the viewer is absent until late.
